TEXT: A hero from a far-off village. Faces the future with Shadow Clones and the power of a beast sealed within.
NL You recall the lessons learned from the people who came before you...

Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison.
